title: Batch Size
statement: Implement `solve(items, size)`. Split `items` into contiguous chunks of length `size`. The last chunk may be shorter. `size` less than 1 returns `error`.
hints: Slice items[i:i+size] while i walks by size.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Shipping one tiny task per row can cost more in pickle and scheduling than the work itself.

editorial: Shipping one tiny task per row can cost more in pickle and scheduling than the work itself. Batching into chunks of a chosen size cuts the number of tasks. The last batch is shorter rather than padded, so the worker sees real items only.
